verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow: product circle, then left-aligned text column, then the CTA on the right. But there is an awkward empty gap between the one-line headline and the body copy, the pills are jammed close to the bottom edge, and the can label is now illegibly small. B's GLACIER wordmark floats centred and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge, and the circle nearly touches the top and bottom edges. B's pill text is also tiny, and its right-hand pill and CTA block crowds the bottom edge, so it reads less deliberate than A.
